About Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University
Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, established on May 1, 1964, stands as Chhattisgarh's
oldest and largest institution of higher education, named in honor of the first Chief Minister
of the erstwhile Madhya Pradesh. For over six decades, PRSU has served as a beacon of
academic excellence, cultural heritage, and intellectual leadership. Situated on a sprawling
300.17-acre campus in the western part of the state capital, Raipur. There are thirty-two
teaching departments in the University. It offers a wide array of programs through its
residential campus, including 31 Ph.D. specializations, 43 postgraduate programs, and 10
undergraduate programs. With a dedicated team of 374 teaching and non-teaching staff, the
University's distinguished, strong academic reputation and advantageous location in a
dynamic city attract students from nearby states seeking advanced study and research
opportunities with its esteemed faculty. There are 161 colleges affiliated to the University. In
the academic year 2025-26, more than 2 lakh students were enrolled in both UG and PG
programs. From 2024-25, the university has implemented the provisions of the NEP 2020 in
the courses offered on campus. The sole objective of this esteemed university in the state is
the holistic development of its students.
About the School of Studies in Life Science
The School of Studies in Life Science, established in
1977, has been imparting quality education and
conducting state-of-the-art research in biological
sciences. It offers postgraduate degrees in
Bioscience, Microbiology, and Biochemistry, and
attracts a large number of students from across the
country.
The School has a strong research profile, with faculty members receiving grants from leading
funding agencies and guiding numerous Ph.D. scholars. It is a proud recipient of DST-FIST
(Phase I & II) and has been recognized as a UGC-SAP department under the DRS Programme
(Phases I, II & III), with Chronobiology as a major thrust area. Supported by research
facilities across diverse fields of modern biology, the School has made significant
contributions to Animal Behavior, Chronobiology, Endocrinology, Environmental Biology,
Ethnobotany, Immunology, Microbial Biochemistry, Parasitology, Plant Tissue Culture, Seed
Biology, Environmental Toxicology, Plant Physiology, Proteomics, Nanobiology, and Cancer
Biology.

Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary lies approximately 100
kilometers away from Raipur, Chhattisgarh. It is a popular

The company has been spearheading the Digital India programme of the Government of India, and is involved in promoting the use of technology for e-Governance/e-Health / Telemedicine, e-agriculture, e-Payments, etc. The Digital India programme promotes safety and security concerns of the growing cashless economy and addresses challenges confronting its wider acceptance. It also promotes innovation and evolves models for the empowerment of citizens through Digital initiatives and promotes participatory governance and citizen engagement across the government through various platforms, including social media. Digital India Corporation

New Delhi – 110003

Website: www.dic.gov.in 
 
 
Web Advertisement 
08.10.2026 
 
Digital India Corporation has been set up by the ‘Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, 
Government of India’, to innovate, develop and deploy ICT and other emerging technologies for the 
benefit of the common man. It is a ‘not for profit’ Company under Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013. 
The Company has been spearheading the Digital India programme of the Government of India, and is 
involved in promoting use of technology for e -Governance / e-Health / Telemedicine, e-agriculture, e-
Payments etc. The Digital India programme promotes safety and security concerns of growing cashless 
economy and addresses challenges confronting its wider acceptance. It also promotes innovation and 
evolves models for empowerment of citizens through Digital initiatives  and promotes participatory 
governance and citizen engagement across the government through various platforms including social 
media.  
 
Digital India Corporation is currently inviting applications for the following positions purely on Contract/ 
Consolidated basis for Poshan Tracker project: - 
 
  Sr. No. Name of the Post No. of 
positions 
1 State Coordinator 12 
** The place of posting shall be in Noida or New Delhi but transferable to project locations of 
Digital India Corporation as per existing policy of Digital India Corporation. 
 
Shortlisting shall be carried out through an objective evaluation matrix based on educational 
qualification, relevant experience, domain expertise, certifications, publications, and other 
criteria as approved by the Competent Authority. Mere fulfilment of eligibility conditions shall 
not confer any right to be shortlisted. 
Digital India Corporation reserves the right to fix higher threshold of qualifications and 
experience for screening and limiting the number of candidates for interview. DIC reserves the 
right not to fill the post without assigning any reason thereof. The d ecision of DIC regarding 
shortlisting shall be final and binding. Only shortlisted candidates shall be invited for selection 
interviews. 
The details can be downloaded from the official website of DIC, NeGD, MyGov & MeitY viz. 
www.dic.gov.in, www.negd.gov.in, www.mygov.in, & www.meity.gov.in 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The details can be downloaded from the official website of DIC viz. www.dic.gov.in 
Eligible candidates may apply ONLINE: https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ 
 
Last date of Receipt of Applications: October 25th, 2026 
 
 
Job Description - State Coordinator 
 
 
Age Limit: 
20-40 Years 
 
 
 
Number of Positions: 12 
 
Sr. 
No. State Name Vacant 
Position 
1 Andhra Pradesh 1 
2 Arunachal 
Pradesh 1 
3 Assam 1 
4 Gujarat 1 
5 Jharkhand 1 
6 Kerala 1 
7 Lakshadweep 1 
8 Maharashtra 1 
9 Mizoram 1 
10 Odisha 1 
11 Puducherry 1 
12 West Bengal 1 
 
Education Qualifications: 
MA Economics, MA Political Science or Any Graduate with relevant years of experience.  
Experience: 
0-5 Years 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Job Description: 
• Carry out monitoring & supervision and review of state level project activities against agreed 
project deliverables. 
• Coordinate with and provide hands on supervision when needed to project staff based at State PMU 
to ensure effective implementation, supervision and follow-up of prison level activities. 
Roles and Responsibilities: 
• Project Management and coordination 
• Lead, support and manage the project implementation in the state 
• Coordinate with key officials/state at State PMU 
• In collaboration with PMU and respective Aids Fond Officer, develop strategic direction and work 
plans (as appropriate) for the project 
• Carry out monitoring & supervision and review of state level project activities against agreed project 
deliverables. 
• Timely preparation and submission of monthly and quarterly project reports  
• Information, Education and Communication (IEC) & Capacity Building 
• Assess the programmatic and technical support needs of the state level staff and plan capacity 
building program/activities for project staff. 
 
 
Consolidated Remuneration:  
• Consolidated remuneration shall be commensurate with qualifications and experience 
within the approved project norms. 
 
 
General Conditions applicable to all applicants covered under this advertisement: 
 
1. Those candidates, who are already in regular or contractual employment under Central / 
State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies, are expected to 
apply through proper channel or attach a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the employer 
concerned with the application OR produce No Objection Certificate at the time of 
interview. 
 
2. Digital India Corporation reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions 
advertised without assigning any reason as it deems fit. 
 
3. Candidates shall disclose any actual or potential conflict of interest with Digital India 
Corporation or its projects. 
 
4. Selected candidate shall furnish an Integrity and Vigilance Declaration and shall be 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
required to maintain highest standards of ethics. 
 
5. Any candidate found debarred, blacklisted or convicted of offences involving moral 
turpitude shall not be eligible. 
 
6. The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of Digital India Corporation 
and the appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at 
Digital India Corporation or on any vacancies existing or that shall be advertised  for 
recruitment by Digital India Corporation in future. 
 
7. Appointment shall remain subject to verification of educational qualifications, previous 
employment, antecedents and character. 
 
8. If any information furnished by the candidate is found false or suppressed at any stage, 
candidature/appointment shall stand cancelled without notice. 
 
9. Selection shall be made by a duly constituted Selection Committee as approved by the 
Competent Authority of DIC. 
 
10. Personal information shall be processed solely for recruitment purposes in accordance with 
applicable laws. 
 
11. Digital India Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  
 
12. The maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications. Screening of 
applications will be based on qualifications, age academic record and relevant experience. 
The designation of the selected candidates shall be mapped as per the existing designation 
policy of DIC. 
 
13. In case of a query, the following officer may be contacted 
 
 
Ms. Vinaya Viswanathan 
Head- HR 
Digital India Corporation  
Electronics Niketan Annexe,6 CGO,  
Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003 
Tel.: +91 120 654 0800

 MAULANA AZAD NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY BHOPAL- 462003 
(An Institution of National importance under Ministry of Education, Govt. of India) 
 
Advt. No. Rectt./FR/2026/1504                          Dated: 07/10/2026 
 
Advertisement for Professor of Practice, Visiting Professor, Adjunct Faculty 
Applications are invited for the position of Professor of Practice, Visiting Professor, Adjunct Faculty 
from distinguished professionals with extensive experience in reputed industries, R&D Institutions, 
National/International Institutes/ Universities. Aim of this position is to promote excellence in 
teaching, research, development Institution-Industry networks and to facilitate interactions. 
 
The institute runs academic programs in following departments: 
 
 
Departments 
Architecture and Planning 
Biological Science and Engineering 
Chemical Engineering 
Chemistry 
Civil Engineering 
Computer Science and Engineering 
Electrical Engineering 
Electronics and Communication Engineering 
Humanities & Social Sciences 
Management Studies 
Materials and Metallurgical Engineering 
Mathematics, Bioinformatics and Computer 
Applications 
Mechanical Engineering 
Physics 
Energy Science and Engineering 
 
  
Who Can Apply: Highly acclaimed, motivated and dynamic industry personnel/ academicians/ 
professionals possessing excellent experience/Research background with commitment and passion 
for quality teaching and potential for pursuing cutting-edge research are encouraged to apply.  
 
Selection Process:  Will be intimated in due course of time.  Persons appointed as Professor of 
Practice/ Visiting Professor/ Adjunct Faculty will have no right or claim for regular appointment or 
continuance of the post in NIT Bhopal.  
 
How to apply: Interested and eligible persons may submit the hard copy of the application form 
along with relevant documents including Curriculum Vitae, list of patents/ copy rights/ important 
publications, specific mention about contributions made to teaching/ training , research, design, 
projects, industrial links etc. to “The Registrar, MANIT Bhopal, Link Road Number 3, Near Kali Mata 
Mandir, Bhopal (M.P.) – 462003” preferably on or before 02/11/2026 through Speed 
Post/Registered Post. The candidates are also required to submit a statement as to how his/her 
experience will benefit to promote Industry-Institute interaction.  
 
The name of the post and department/centre must be super-scribed “Post applied for [name of the 
post] Department/centre [Name of the department]” clearly on the envelope without fail.  
 
 
 
 
 
1. Professor-of-Practice (PoP) 
ELIGIBILITY/ QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE: 
Candidates should have more than 15 years of professional experience at the level of senior management 
position for Professor of Practice. They should have at least a master's degree in 
engineering/sciences/humanities or a related field. Ph.D. is desirable  but not essential. However, a lack of 
Ph.D. must be offset by demonstrated domain knowledge, obtained from deep experience in the desired 
field.  
 
CRITERIA OF ENGAGEMENT: 
1. Design, development and offering of new practice-oriented courses.    
2. Advise students in their projects linking them with appropriate external stakeholders. 
3. Engage in department building activities including creation of new programs and cent res and 
enhancement of scope and activities of the department. 
4. To develop Continuing Education Programs, undertake outreach activities and conduct extension 
programs. 
5. Encourage students in innovation and entrepreneurship projects and provide necessary mentorship for 
these activities 
6. Contribute to enhanced industry academia collaborations. 
7. In addition, he/she may be assigned any administrative duties/responsibilities in the interest of Institute 
as may be deemed appropriate by the Director. 
 
REMUNERATION: 
Emoluments-Professor of Practice will be paid a Consolidated emolument upto Rs. 1,75,000/- per month and 
shall not exceed the Last Pay minus Pension as applicable in case of reemployment after retirement. 
 
No increment, Dearness Allowance or any other allowance shall be admissible. The emoluments shall remain 
fixed /unchanged during the period of engagement as PoP. 
 
Further, applicable expenses for attending conference, seminar, incurred as per the Institute rule upto Rs. 
20,000/- per month shall be considered for reimbursement, subject to an annual ceiling of Rs. 1,00,000-/ per 
year. 
 
LEAVE ARRANGEMENT: 
A Professor of Practice shall be entitled to 8 days of Casual Leave (CL) and 15 days of Special Casual Leave 
(SCL) per year for undertaking academic or research activities outside the Institute. Any unutilized leave at 
the end of the year shall lapse and shall not be carried forward to the subsequent year. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
2. Visiting Professor 
ELIGIBILITY/ QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE:  
PhD in the respective field and possessing one of the degrees from the Centrally Funded Institution (CFIs) 
under the Ministry of Education, Government of India.  
A person retired from Govt. organization/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/Govt. R & D lab. /PSUs shall be entitled for visiting 
faculty.  
Experience of 15 years after PhD for Visiting Professor 
EXPOSURE/WORK RELATED:                                                                               
1. Product design and development/Project R&D/Patent products/ New application of materials or process 
etc 
2. Guided internships/student projects. 
3. Work experience from world class universities/ top rated research institutions, national labs or fellows of 
prestigious academies. 
4. Research publications in SCI/WoS journals/Patents granted/ Technology Transfer executed. 
5. Collaboration with funding agencies/research labs of global organizations/ universities/ consultancy 
works leading to revenue generation etc 
6. Exposure in Start-ups/unicorns. 
 
CRITERIA OF ENGAGEMENT: 
1. Academic interactions with students and faculty of the Department/Institute 
2. Deliver seminars and/or hold technical discussion sessions with students and faculty 
3. Participation in teaching, full course or part of a course 
4. Design, development and offering of new courses 
5. Research collaboration with existing Faculty 
6. Co-guidance of students 
7. Advise students in their projects and link them with appropriate external stakeholders 
8. Encourage students in innovation and entrepreneurship projects and provide necessary mentorship for 
their activities 
9. Engage in industry-academia collaborations 
REMUNERATION:  
Maximum monthly ceiling of Rs. 1,50,000/- and shall not exceed the Last Pay minus Pension as applicable in 
case of reemployment after retirement. 
 
No increment, Dearness Allowance or any other allowance shall be admissible. The emoluments shall remain 
fixed /unchanged during the period of engagement. 
 
Further, applicable expenses for attending conference, seminar, incurred as per the Institute rule upto Rs. 
20,000/- per month shall be considered for reimbursement, subject to an annual ceiling of Rs. 1,00,000-/ per 
year. 
or 
Rs. 3000/-per period/Rs. 10000/- per day + TA (As per Institute norms), Maximum monthly ceiling of Rs. 
1,50,000 (Including TA) per month. 
 
LEAVE ARRANGEMENT: 
A Visiting Professor shall be entitled to 8 days of Casual Leave (CL) and 15 days of Special Casual Leave (SCL) 
per year for undertaking academic or research activities outside the Institute. Any unutilized leave at the end 
of the year shall lapse and shall not be carried forward to the subsequent year 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
3. Adjunct Faculty 
ELIGIBILITY/ QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE: 
Adjunct Professor: PhD in the respective field and possessing one of the degrees from the Centrally Funded 
Institution (CFIs) under the Ministry of Education, Government of India with 15 years’ experience in the 
relevant field in R&D labs/IITs/NITs and Expert in domain area.      
CRITERIA OF ENGAGEMENT: 
I. Teach Core/ Elective courses in UG and PG in which the person’s practical experience and knowledge can 
add significant value to theory as per the need of academic Departments. 
II. The Adjunct Faculty will also be associated with the setting of examination papers and the general work 
of evaluating students’ performance in the subject the teaching of which he/she is associated with. 
III. Supervise student projects and co-supervise research scholars with a view to adding practical dimensions 
to their work. 
The Adjunct Faculty can be a Joint investigator in sponsored R&D and consultancy projects, bringing in 
significant expertise to match industry needs and expectations. 
IV. Promote industry –academia collaboration in advanced research to generate intellectual property, 
overcome technological barriers to global competitiveness, and strengthen the quality and scope of the 
Institute’s research-driven industrial consultancy. 
V. Support Institute development activities with an industry interface, e.g. sponsored & top up programs, 
Chair Professorships, awards and scholarships, CSR funding, projects etc. 
VI. The Adjunct Faculty member shall actively engage in departmental service activities, including committee 
participation, faculty and student mentoring, professional networking, and facilitating internship and 
career opportunities for students 
REMUNERATION: 
 
Rs. 3000/-per period/Rs., 10000/- per day + TA (As per Institute norms), subject to monthly ceiling of Rs. 
1,50,000 (Including TA) per month. 
 
 
 
 
General Instructions:    
1. Persons appointed as PoP/Visiting Professor/Adjunct Faculty will have no right or claim for regular 
appointment or continuance of the post other than the terms specified.  
2. The consolidated remuneration fixed at the time of joining shall remain unchanged throughout the 
period of appointment. For all remunerations, tax deduction shall be as applicable as per norms.  
3. The application form provided in Annexure I for the position of ‘Professor of Practice’ and Annexure 
II for the position of ‘Visiting Professor/Adjunct Faculty ’ must be duly filled in and signed. Self -
attested photocopies of the relevant certificates, testimonials, research publications (if any), and 
other supporting documents must be enclosed with the application form. The complete application 
should reach to “The Registrar, MANIT Bhopal, Link Road Number 3, Near Kali Mata Mandir, Bhopal 
(M.P.) – 462003” preferably on or before 02/11/2026 through Speed Post. The candidates are also 
required to submit a statement as to how his/her experience will benefit to promote Industry -
Institute interaction.  
4. A copy of the CV has to be attached to the application form. 
5. Persons employed in Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, PSUs, Universities, or other 
educational institutions should submit the application through proper channel or produce a No 
Objection Certificate and Vigilance Clearance. 
6. The Institute reserves the right not to fill up any / all  position(s) / select any candidate without 
assigning any reason.   
7. Mere fulfilling of the minimum qualifications and experience will not confer any right to the 
candidates for his/her selection.   
8. The Institute reserves the right to modify, withdraw, or terminate the recruitment process or any 
position at any stage, if deemed necessary in the best interest of the Institute.  
9. Canvassing in any form, whether directly or indirectly, will lead to the disqualification of the 
candidature.  
10. Candidates are requested to visit the website regularly for updates. 
Registrar 
 
Integrity Pact & Appointment of IEM 
 
Government of India, Ministry of Education has issued OM No: C -
34014/03/2021-Vig. Dated 03/01/2022 in which threshold limit i.e. 
1.00 Crore has been decided  for implementation of Integrity Pact for 
major Procurement activities  includes Works, Goods and Services  as 
far as autonomous bodies are concerned.  In compliance of said OM 
Integrity Pact shall be signed between the prospective Vendors/ 
Bidders and buyer committing the persons/ officials of both sides, not 
to resort to any corrupt practices in any aspect/ stage of contract.  A 
summary of procurement/ contract awarded, which are covered under 
the Integrity Pact shall be compulsorily shared with the independent 
External monitors on quarterly basis.  
 
Accordingly, letter No: 23/VGL/122/20794 &         dated 05/03/2024  
from Central Vigilance Commission New Delhi  and OM No: C -
34014/1/2022 –vig dated 04/04/2024  from GoI, MoE, Department of 
Higher Education, Vigilance Section, following appointment of 
Independent External Monitor (IEM) are made: 
 
Shri OM Prakash Dadhich IRS Retd. Shri Yogendra Tripathi, IAS Retd. 
Email: opdadhich@hotmail.com Email: yogendratripathi@yahoo.com 
 
 
 
 
Refund Policy 
Refunds will be returned using the original method of payment – for example if a donation has 
been made by credit card, the refund will be credited by same mode of Channel to same credit 
card by the Merchant and this goes for all Pay Modes from which the customer will make the 
Payment. 
Also, If the required product is not as per the selection done by the customer, then customer 
can get back to us within 10 working days and refund would take place as per Banks 
TAT/norms. 
Cancellation Policy 
Once the product is dispatched then cancellation policy won't be entertained before that 
within 5 to 6 days Customer can cancel the product before it gets delivered. 
Or Else tell Merchant to update Disclaimer on the Website. 
Refund/Cancellation won't be entertained once Customer makes the payment.
